items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: And this band he was rehearsing, he had Omer Sim?on, Barney Bigard and myself in the reed section... Paul Barbarin was on drums.

ctx.x: He was originally from New Orleans, but he came up to Chicago. And he had Paul Barbarin. He was on his way to, you know, build up something, you know. Then the only thing -- there's one thing I always regretted. Then he started rehearsing the band up at the Renaissance, and
he was supposed to take this band in the Roseland, see. Rose Danceland and Roseland is two different places.
